package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_data_structure_choice_slice_queue_pop_front: Layer: Data structure choice. Flag queue-style slice reslicing from the front that can retain backing arrays or shift too much data.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario522Queue struct {
	items []string
}

func scenario522NewQueue() *scenario522Queue {
	return &scenario522Queue{items: make([]string, 0)}
}

func (q *scenario522Queue) Push(item string) {
	q.items = append(q.items, item)
}

func (q *scenario522Queue) Pop() (string, bool) {
	if len(q.items) == 0 {
		return "", false
	}
	front := q.items[0]
	q.items = q.items[1:]
	return front, true
}

func (q *scenario522Queue) ProcessAll(fn func(string)) {
	for {
		item, ok := q.Pop()
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		fn(item)
	}
}
